title: MosChip® Technologies
description: Full-stack Edge AI and product engineering for Infineon PSoC™ Edge platforms
long_description:
MosChip Technologies is an Infineon Associated Partner helping OEMs build intelligent, secure and connected edge products on Infineon PSoC™ Edge platforms.

Our services cover platform enablement and integration, hardware support for rapid prototypes, BSPs, firmware and middleware, and Edge AI model development, customization, optimization, integration and deployment. We work across embedded vision, audio, sensor fusion and on-device inference, and can extend solutions through IoT, cloud, mobile applications, automation and production lifecycle engineering.

MosChip also develops reference designs and solution accelerators for connected healthcare, smart home, wearables and industrial products. Representative work includes a smart medication box on PSoC™ Edge E84 using on-device face recognition, DEEPCRAFT™ voice keyword spotting, proximity sensing, BLE synchronization and an Android caregiver application.

Our Infineon platform experience includes PSoC™ Edge, ModusToolbox™ software and DEEPCRAFT™ Edge AI. Customers can engage MosChip from proof of concept and model porting through product integration, validation and production readiness.
